turns.text: [shouting over the engine roar] AND WE ARE LIVE from the Gold Coast! [fast, breathless] The Boost Mobile Gold Coast 500 — the Surfers Paradise street circuit is LOUD, the grandstands are full — [building] and every building, every barrier, every metre of fence out there was put there by ONE team! [shouting] This is THEIR story!

[rapid] Forty-seven days! From the first truck through the gate on the seventh of September — to race day, Friday the twenty-third of October! [fast] Seven hundred and twenty-seven pieces of equipment! Twenty kilometres of fencing work! [punchy] Sun, wind, and a LOT of rain — [shouting] and they got it DONE!
[warm, grinning] So settle in, grab a cold drink — [laughs] and if you're one of the people in this story, sit up straight... [building] because we're about to talk about YOU!

[race-caller, warm] Running the Coates show on site — the project manager — Andrew Fisher! [fast] Thirty-four days on the ground, three hundred and sixty-one hours! [laughs] Every building, every toilet, every barrier ticked off on the record by the same thumb — [shouting] somebody get that man a new phone!

[race-caller, naming them like the grid] And the install team! Aaron Zelvis! Kyle Gover! Alfie Harris! Daniel Gough! [fast] Jayden Paul! Wayne Crimmin! [punchy] And for race weekend — Ludwig Chee on the tools and Frank Devilles on the power! [shouting] THAT — is the crew!

[building, with real respect] Let's start at the top. Aaron Zelvis — the man who LED the install! [fast] There on day one, the seventh of September, and there ever since — thirty-three days, three hundred and sixty-seven hours on the ground! [punchy] Years of experience — and you could see every single one of them out there!

[driving] Aaron got everyone MOVING! [rapid] Where it goes, how it goes, who's on it, what's next — [punchy] one call, one direction, and the whole crew rolling! [warm] Trucks landing, plans changing, rain coming in sideways — [shouting] Aaron had it! [laughs] If Aaron says it's going there... mate, it's going there!

[excited] Kyle Gover! [fast] Nineteen days, nearly a hundred and ninety hours, on site from the fourteenth of September! [building] Every time you needed a pair of hands that knew exactly what they were doing — [shouting] Kyle was already there! An absolute LEGEND!

[excited] Alfie Harris! [fast] Day one, the seventh of September, right beside Aaron — twenty-seven days, nearly two hundred and ninety hours! [punchy] Building after building, toilet after toilet, load after load — [shouting] Alfie, you are a LEGEND!

[excited] Daniel Gough! [fast] In from the twenty-eighth of September, straight into the busiest weeks of the whole build — eighteen days, more than a hundred and ninety hours! [building] Heads down, gloves on, every single day — [shouting] Daniel — LEGEND!

[serious, heartfelt] Kyle. Alfie. Daniel. Over and beyond — every single day. [slower] With Aaron, more than a thousand hours on this circuit between the four of them. [quiet, sincere] And let's say it straight... this does not happen without them. Not one bit of it. [building] We could NOT have done it without them!

[warm, fast] And the extra hands when it counted! Jayden Paul! Wayne Crimmin! [punchy] Ludwig Chee keeping every machine turning — Frank Devilles keeping every light on! [laughs] If it beeps, smokes or won't start — [shouting] these are the blokes you call!

[driving, over the engine] Now — what did they BUILD? [shouting] FIFTY-TWO buildings! [rapid] Twenty-three six-metre offices! Fourteen four-point-eights! Six twelve-metre buildings! Three nine-point-sixes! [fast] Ticket boxes, containers, and a cool room — [laughs] the most popular building on site, no question!

[rapid-fire, naming them] A team office for every garage in pit lane — Triple Eight! DJR! Walkinshaw! Grove! Erebus! Brad Jones! Matt Stone! PremiAir! Blanchard! Team Eighteen! [fast] The Event Control Centre! Race Medical! The police command post! Ambulance! Fire! St John! Security! Accreditation! The ticket boxes at the gates! [shouting] ALL of it — Coates!

[fast, pointing] And not one of them just dropped and left! [punchy] All fifty-two positioned and LEVELLED! Forty-two sets of stairs — set, checked, ticked! [laughs] That's leg day, every day! [building] First one on the ground the fourteenth of September — every single one complete by the fifteenth of October — [shouting] thirty-one days, start to finish!

[excited] Now the BIG number! TWO HUNDRED AND SIXTY-FIVE toilets! [rapid] Two hundred and thirty-six fresh-water-flush units! Fifteen six-metre blocks! Two sixteen-pan blocks! Four accessible units, two trailers, six pee panels — [fast] across seventy-four locations, from the pit paddock to the far end of Main Beach!

[laughs] And let's be honest — on race day, these are the most important buildings on the circuit! [fast] First ones in on the fourteenth of September — every last one complete on the twentieth of October! [shouting] Two hundred and sixty-five — one hundred per cent!

[driving] And every race night, every single one pumped out, cleaned, restocked and signed off with its own QR code! [rapid] Two hundred and sixty-six units, seventy-five locations, fifteen areas — [punchy] while the rest of the Gold Coast is fast asleep! [shouting] To the night crews — THANK YOU!

[rapid] Twenty-four variable message boards! [fast] Every one towed into position, set and switched on — every rego and fleet number on the record! [laughs] Twenty-four boards — and not ONE of them flashing 'are we there yet'! [shouting] All twenty-four — DONE!

[driving] Fourteen generators! [rapid] Two two-hundred-kVA sets with cables, a one-fifty, four sixties, two fifties, a forty-five, two thirties, two twenties — [fast] in from the twenty-eighth of September, every one running by the nineteenth of October! [shouting] The POWER behind the whole precinct!

[fast] Seven light towers! Thirty trakmats! [rapid] Forklifts — two-and-a-half tonne, three-and-a-half, five tonne, rough terrain! [punchy] A forty-three-foot scissor lift, a sixty-foot straight boom, a sixty-one-foot knuckle boom! [laughs] A forklift for every job — and a job for every forklift! [shouting] Every machine — ON SITE!

[serious, driving] And the ones that keep people SAFE! [rapid] Three hundred and eleven crash-rated, water-filled Armorzone barriers — every one of them placed! [fast] The Gold Coast Highway — Tedder Avenue, Turn Two, the light rail at Main Beach — a hundred and fifty-four of them along the grandstands at Macintosh Park alone! [punchy] Main Beach Parade! Admiralty Drive! Helen Park! Commodore Park! The Turn Eleven run-off! The racing kerbs!

[laughs] Filled with WATER — and in event week, somehow still the driest thing on site! [fast] First ones placed on the fourteenth of September — the last ones set the day before race day! [shouting] Three hundred and eleven barriers — one hundred per cent!

[rapid, commentating] And the TRUCKS! [fast] Seven hundred and twenty-seven pieces of equipment — a hundred and twenty-one Coates asset numbers on hire! [building] The biggest day, the sixteenth of October — twenty-five references landed in ONE day! [shouting] Every load tracked, every arrival on the record!

[driving, over the engine] And NOW — the crew that wraps the WHOLE circuit! [race-caller, naming them] Wayne Woods leads the Advanced Temporary Fencing crew — Owen Cowell McPaul! Daniel Macleod! Cody Woods! Chase Hireni! Tahi Peni! Daniel Smith! Scott Hildebrand! Hayden McAvoy! [shouting] Give them a ROAR!

[warm, proud] And here's the thing about Wayne's crew. [fast] From the public — from the residents living right beside the circuit — from V8 Supercars management — [building] nothing but positive feedback. Nothing but praise. [shouting] THAT is how you represent a job!

[sincere] Fencing isn't glamorous. Panel after panel, clamp after clamp, [building] in the wind, in the rain, with the traffic going past — [punchy] and when it's done right, nobody even notices it's there. [shouting] Well we NOTICED, Wayne — and it was done RIGHT!

[fast, building] THIRTEEN KILOMETRES of temporary fence standing! [punchy] Thirteen thousand one hundred and eighty-seven metres — [rapid] more than five hundred metres MORE than the programme asked for! [laughs] Walk it end to end and you'd want a packed lunch! [shouting] THIRTEEN K!

[rapid] A hundred and sixty-two dockets! [fast] Thirty-one days of fencing, from the ninth of September to the twenty-second of October! [building] And in event week alone — forty dockets in four days! [shouting] Forty in four — that is FLYING!

[rapid-fire] Five thousand one hundred and ninety mesh panels! [fast] Eight thousand two hundred and ten feet! [laughs] That's more feet than a centipede convention! [building] Two hundred and sixteen concrete blocks — every panel carried, stood and squared up by hand — [shouting] foot by foot, around the whole circuit!

[fast] Seven thousand nine hundred and thirty-six clamps! Fourteen hundred and twenty-six braces! [punchy] A hundred and twenty-eight vehicle gates! Twenty-two pedestrian gates! Forty-one hoarding panels! [fast] Every gate hung, every wheel on, every one swinging — [shouting] the small pieces, the BIG effort!

[driving] Then the crowd control! [rapid] Seven point two kilometres of crowd-control barrier — two thousand eight hundred and seventy-nine barrier units! [fast] Two point one kilometres on the event lines, five point one of demarcation, and two hundred and seventy metres of flat feet where the ground said so! [shouting] Every section in — every section STANDING!

[fast] And the work you do TWICE! [rapid] Four point four kilometres of scrim fitted along the fence lines! Nearly six hundred metres of fence relocated when the plan moved! [punchy] More than a kilometre already taken down and stacked away! [laughs] Fence that MOVES with the event — [shouting] and a crew that moves FASTER!

[punchy] Corporate! Pit lane! The paddock! Main Beach! The Esplanade! Helen Park! Ocean Avenue! The compounds! [fast] Every docket tied to the area it went in — [building] so when the record says a run is standing — [shouting] it's standing EXACTLY where the drawings say!

[fast, summing up] Put it all together — the fence, the crowd control, the flat feet — [building] twenty kilometres of fencing work around the precinct! [punchy] Wayne Woods and the Advanced crew — [shouting] twenty K, in the wind, in the rain, and done RIGHT!

[laughing] And the WEATHER! [fast] Beautiful one day, perfect the next — [laughs] said NOBODY in event week! [rapid] Ninety-four millimetres of rain in the last ten days — nine wet mornings out of ten! [building] Sixty-five millimetres in event week alone — [shouting] and the fence went up anyway!

[fast, warm] The wind? Gusts over fifty kilometres an hour on fifteen days — six days straight in the middle of October! [rapid] The big one — sixty-three, on the seventh of October! [punchy] Coldest morning twelve point nine degrees — hottest day twenty-nine point nine! [shouting] And they built through ALL of it!

[sincere, building] Forty-seven days on the Bureau's records — eighteen wet mornings, more than a hundred and thirteen millimetres of rain. [punchy] Wet boots, wet gloves, wet everything — [shouting] and the crews kept turning up, boots on, ready to go!

[sincere, fast] Pre-starts every morning — fifty-eight of them on the record, Coates and fencing side by side! [rapid] Loads walked round, spotters called, clearances checked! [building] And not one breakdown on the record — [shouting] that is how you run a site!

[fast, proud] Close to fifteen hundred hours of Coates hands on this circuit by race day! [punchy] Ground that shifts, levels, stairs, access, forklifts — hands and judgement! [shouting] Every lift called, every load spotted, every job finished!

[fast] The dates that made it! [rapid] The seventh of September — the first truck! The fourteenth — the first buildings, the first toilets, the first barriers! The fifteenth of October — every building complete! The sixteenth — twenty-five references in one day! [building] The twentieth — every toilet! The twenty-second — every barrier! [shouting] And this weekend — RACE WEEKEND!

[proud, over the roar] Buildings — one hundred per cent! Toilets — one hundred per cent! Water barriers — one hundred per cent! [rapid] Generators! Lights! Message boards! Forklifts and access! [building] One hundred, one hundred, one hundred! [shouting] SEVEN areas at one hundred per cent!

[building, awed] Seven hundred and twenty-seven pieces of equipment — every one booked for race weekend — ON SITE! [fast] Thirteen kilometres of fence! Seven kilometres of crowd control! Twenty kilometres of fencing work, all up! [slower, letting it land] Stop and think about that for a second... [shouting] WE did that!

[punchy, one at a time] Care Deeply! Customer Focused! Be Our Best! One Team! Competitive Spirit! [driving] Those are the Coates values — [fast] and for nearly seven weeks on this circuit you could SEE them — in a careful lift, a clear call, a mate with a hand out!

[warm, sincere] One team. Coates and Advanced, install and fencing, side by side — [building] nobody standing back, nobody saying 'not my job'. [slower] Because if one crew didn't do what they did... [shouting] none of us would be where we are today!

[warm, fast] Special mentions! [rapid] To the branches and the yard who loaded every truck — to the drivers who got them here — to the night crews on the QR codes — [punchy] to Rob Simmons and the iEDM team — and to V8 Supercars for having us! [shouting] THANK YOU!

[race-caller, naming them] Andrew Fisher! Aaron Zelvis! Kyle Gover! Alfie Harris! Daniel Gough! Jayden Paul! Wayne Crimmin! Ludwig Chee! Frank Devilles! [fast] And on the fence — Wayne Woods! Owen Cowell McPaul! Daniel Macleod! Cody Woods! Chase Hireni! Tahi Peni! Daniel Smith! Scott Hildebrand! Hayden McAvoy! [shouting] THIS is the team that built the GC five hundred!

[the roar dropping away, slow, sincere] So this weekend... when the cars scream past and the crowd is on its feet... [softly] take a second. [emotional] Every barrier they lean on... every fence they walk past... every light that's on... [quiet] somebody in this team put it there.
[softly, emotional] Every one of you... deserves to be recognised. [pause] Thank you. [building again] Now go and enjoy it — [shouting] because YOU built it!
[lifting again, into the engine, fast] Stay with us! [shouting] Another lap with the Coates twenty-six — and another look at the legends who built the GC five hundred!

[energetic, shouting over the engine] Back LIVE with the Coates twenty-six on the Gold Coast! [fast] Just joining us — this is the crew that built the GC five hundred, from the first truck to race day! [shouting] Here's how they did it!
